title: Father and Daughter Swimming in Ocean, 1950s Beach B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot depicting a father holding his young daughter while wading in gentle ocean waves. Both are smiling at the camera, enjoying a sunny day at the seaside. The photo showcases post-World War II family vacation culture and mid-century recreational leisure fashion with traditional swimsuits and scalloped deckle-edge photographic paper.
